name: Company read-only Samba connector
provenance: Official maintainer repositories and official PyPI release metadata/wheel SHA256 values. Company-owned source, fixed Dockerfiles and immutable digest. No generated connector executable or installation scripts.
runtimeGuards: One exact application, connection, logical root and ordinary share; one literal unicast IPv4 destination on TCP 445
Separate app-scoped adapter bearer, relay bearer and dedicated remote readonly account; no share credentials in generated code or application mounts
HTTPS adapter and verified TLS relay; SMB3.1.1 only, signing requested and session encryption mandatory; NTLMv2-only client setting; no guest fallback
Low-level protocol operations only; no DFS referral shares, no automatic symlink resolution, reparse points refused, held readonly ancestor handles
Only FILE_OPEN with read/list access; no writes, creates, deletes, rename, ACL update, RPC administration or host CIFS/UNC mounts
gVisor, UID10001, readonly root, dropped capabilities, no new privileges, 256MiB/64 processes/0.5CPU, 16MiB tmpfs, no published ports or host/socket mounts
Adapter has only private app/connector networks; trusted sealed relay has private connector plus dedicated egress network
16MiB read, 1000-entry list, 24 path segments, bounded bodies, request rates, two tunnels, eight-second absolute tunnel/operation lifetime, 32MiB tunnel traffic
Owner MFA and exact signed five-minute approval; immutable scope and credentials; maximum ninety-day grant; encrypted broker state and encrypted volume scoped readonly secret mounts
Fresh independent MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL and unknown-severity package/image checks required before provisioning and daily in app security reports
Seven-day encrypted journal receives only redacted operation/outcome/timing; no filenames, file contents, share/account names, passwords or tokens

Per-candidate capability directory and bearer; failed candidate leaves routed release scope unchanged; prior provenance-verified sidecars retired by immutable container ID after confirmed route activation
Docker embedded DNS is not used by gVisor; trusted exact-network IP host mappings preserve private TLS SAN verification
requiredCustomerEvidence: A dedicated remote account whose server-side ACL permits read/list only and confines it to this one share
A company-reviewed evidence record of those ACLs, bound by SHA256 to the approved scope
Approved literal IP destination and encrypted SMB3.1.1 server; independent live root listing before app deployment

qualification.localPolicyTests: 10/10 passed inside pinned Linux connector image with actual SDK; Windows policy run 9 passed, SDK-only test unavailable
qualification.companyImageScan: unavailable until company build runs with fresh advisory feeds
qualification.realSyntheticSMBProtocol: passed on Rocky10.2 foundation 2026-10-10T12:36:58Z; exact source/image binding in deploy/verification/rocky10.2-samba-protocol.json
qualification.customerServerACLAndConnectivity: unavailable until separately reviewed and checked

limits: Trusted relay code enforces the single destination. A compromised relay process has its dedicated external network; this is not a claim of kernel-enforced destination firewalling.
The account's server-side share ACL is the dataset boundary. A client cannot prove remote write restrictions merely by making read-only requests.
Arbitrary subtree isolation inside a broad share, DFS, Kerberos, write operations and SMB1/2/3.0 downgrade are not supported.
Package review and scan results are evidence at a point in time; future vulnerabilities block provisioning/publication until fixed or explicitly reported.
